title: Quantum XChange Phio TX Becomes First Post-Quantum Cryptographic Management Platform to Earn EUCC Certification - Quantum Computing Report
gist: Quantum XChange's PhioTX-V v4.5.6 cryptographic management software won EU Cybersecurity Certification (EUCC) at EAL2, making Phio TX the first post-quantum cryptography management platform to hold both EUCC and U.S. FIPS validation. The software-only, crypto-agile overlay lets enterprises add PQC and QKD interfaces without replacing hardware, and the dual transatlantic validation is pitched as a procurement shortcut for banks, telcos and governments.

themes.theme: First dual EUCC + FIPS PQC platform

insights.claim: Quantum XChange's PhioTX-V cryptographic management software (version 4.5.6) received EU Cybersecurity Certification (EUCC), making Phio TX the first post-quantum cryptography management platform to hold both EUCC certification and U.S. FIPS validation.
insights.so_what: A first-mover regulatory credential on both sides of the Atlantic is a moat in PQC sales cycles to regulated buyers; watch whether competitors follow with EUCC filings.
insights.quote: Phio TX becomes the first post-quantum cryptography (PQC) management platform to hold both EUCC certification and U.S. Federal Information Processing Standards (FIPS) validation
insights.locator: Quantum-safe network security provider Quantum XChange
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem

insights.claim: The PhioTX-V EUCC certificate (ID EUCC-3095-2026-03 under Regulation (EU) 2024/482) was evaluated under CC:2022 Rev. 1 at EAL2 (substantial assurance), issued by DEKRA Testing and Certification S.A.U. under oversight of Spain's Centro Criptológico Nacional, and is valid Nov 10, 2026 to Nov 9, 2031.
insights.so_what: EAL2 is a moderate assurance tier; buyers requiring higher EAL levels may still need additional evaluation, while the five-year validity window locks in eligibility through 2031.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem

insights.claim: Phio TX is a software-only virtual Key Management Entity (KME) that delivers distributed symmetric keys via ETSI GS QKD 014 and Cisco SKIP APIs, securing Secure Application Entity links with multi-PQC peer KME exchange and mutual TLS, with security support through March 16, 2029.
insights.so_what: Support for Cisco SKIP and the ETSI QKD key-delivery standard means Phio TX plugs into installed network gear, lowering adoption friction versus hardware-centric quantum-safe vendors.
insights.locator: Certified Architecture row of certification table
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem

insights.claim: Because Phio TX separates key generation and distribution from data transport, enterprises can integrate post-quantum algorithms and quantum key distribution alongside existing encryption appliances without hardware replacement.
insights.so_what: A no-rip-and-replace PQC migration path favors software overlay vendors over appliance sellers in the coming quantum-safe upgrade cycle.
insights.quote: Designed as a crypto-agile overlay that separates key generation and distribution from data transport
insights.locator: Administered across the European Union under
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem

insights.claim: Quantum XChange CEO Eddy Zervigon and Evolutio CEO Jacinto Cavestany say independent transatlantic validation (EUCC plus FIPS) simplifies procurement reviews and supports cross-border data sovereignty mandates for financial institutions, telecom carriers, and government agencies.
insights.so_what: Certification is becoming the gating factor for PQC sales into regulated sectors; Evolutio's involvement hints at a Spanish telecom channel for European deployments.
insights.quote: independent transatlantic validation simplifies procurement reviews and supports cross-border data sovereignty mandates
insights.locator: According to Quantum XChange Chief Executive Officer
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem

insights.claim: EUCC, administered across the EU under the Common Criteria framework, sets standardized third-party testing requirements for ICT products deployed in regulated networks, making it a de facto entry ticket for security vendors selling into EU regulated infrastructure.
insights.so_what: Track EUCC certifications as a leading indicator of which PQC vendors can actually compete for EU regulated-network contracts.
